channel_quantifier: ONE common full-domain channel for every promised label; both broadcaster outputs charged
supplied_information: Integer K and rational active weight w; exact qubit occupation bases and flag decomposition.
Unknown-direction promised inputs already contain N_j=2^j copies in supplied symmetric sectors; no new copies or label identification are provided for free.
Exact finite design labels, quadrature-root isolations, positive algebraic weights and root-of-unity phases.
Rational faithfulness perturbation eta=(w/K)^2 and normalized identity on the complete Hilbert space.
For the nonuniform theorem: d,J,rational p_j,w, fixed exact degree-2N_J design and symmetric bases.
acquired_derivations: Exact arbitrary-EB shifted witness and logarithmic gap, including arbitrary vacuum preparations.
Decoder lower bound on actual optimal b2 rather than only the displayed division error.
Exact convex-minimax radius and max-prior capacity for unperturbed promises.
Vacuum scaling, two parameter regimes, and finite faithful endpoint2 obstruction.
Exact quantile optimum for nonuniform strict flag-lowering division and its scoped logarithmic rate.
Ancillary neutrality and orthogonal-output coherent failure.

runtime_interface.input: One promised density rho_psi, unknown psi; full channel must also be CP TP on arbitrary B(H).
runtime_interface.output: Two marginal reconstructions for B, one reconstruction for EB Lambda. Correlations allowed.
runtime_interface.measurement_oracle: No runtime label, hidden key, free state-identification oracle, free Haar sampler or postselection. EB upper channels have exact finite POVM implementations.
runtime_interface.target_quantities: Worst HALF error over every finite design label, not an average-only error; information radius minimized over all convex centers.

qubit_family_representation.dense_broadcaster_choi_entries: D^6 (input D, output D^2), not materialized
qubit_family_representation.split_kraus_structure: K-1 grouping isometries plus three rank-one replacement Kraus operators; total occupation nonzeros O(m^2).
qubit_family_representation.design_node_representation: Each y is an isolated real root of the rational shifted Legendre polynomial of degree q; minimal algebraic degree<=q. Exact weights and square-root coordinates also require charged algebraic arithmetic.
qubit_family_representation.faithfulness: Every eigenvalue at least eta/D, with eta=(w/K)^2>0.

parameter_regimes.representation_caution: D grows exponentially in K, hence exponentially in inverse square-root error. No polynomial-acquisition claim.

parameter_regimes.size_in_inverse_error: D=O(1/[b2 ln(1/b2)]), label count=O(1/[b2^2 ln(1/b2)^2]). Exact arithmetic/precision and full matrix costs remain charged.

nonuniform_cost_boundary.copy_and_design_cost: N_J=2^J; degree t=2N_J. A product quadrature uses q=N_J+1 Jacobi nodes per stick coordinate and r=2N_J+1 phases, giving at most [(N_J+1)(2N_J+1)]^(d-1) algebraic labels. This is an elementary supplied upper bound, not an optimized design cardinality.
nonuniform_cost_boundary.probabilities: Quantile endpoints and conditional transition laws rational supplied data.
nonuniform_cost_boundary.channels: Grouping with a discarded remainder is CPTP on all inputs; EB iteration is one flag-reading measure-prepare map, not an input-dependent channel choice.
nonuniform_cost_boundary.comparison: Class-optimal b_div is not globally optimal b2 unless a separate comparison theorem is proved.

performed_computation.proof_type: Exact analytic inequalities and finite-object specification; independent exposed review separate.
performed_computation.integrity_checks: JSON parsing, frozen hash verification, old freeze verification and read-only git status/pin checks only.

costs_not_claimed_free: Exact design construction/root isolation and algebraic precision.
